summary: Run the backup from the install directory, for example `./setup.sh -e 'backup_dest=/ansible/mybackup' -e 'use_archive_compression=true' -e 'use_db_compression=true' -e @credentials.yml -b`. `backup_dir` is the staging dir; compression can be global or per component (`<componentName>_use_archive_compression`, `_use_db_compression`); output is `automation-platform-backup-<date/time>.tar.gz`.
questions: How do I run an AAP backup with setup.sh?
What is the difference between backup_dir and backup_dest?
How do I compress AAP backups per component?
Where is the AAP backup file created?

answer_card.title: Back up with setup.sh (RPM)
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
cd <installation directory>
./setup.sh -e 'backup_dest=/ansible/mybackup' \
  -e 'use_archive_compression=true' -e 'use_db_compression=true' \
  -e @credentials.yml -b
```
Result: `/ansible/mybackup/automation-platform-backup-<date/time>.tar.gz`. `backup_dir` is the staging dir on each host (default `/var/backups/automation-platform`).
